embeddings.note: identical and free across arms; not the Voyage-4 production default

seeds.rng: none: ingest order, query order and conversation selection are deterministic

modes.default: /recall as shipped. The keyword leg only fills slots the vector leg leaves empty (recall.py remaining_slots), so with limit=10 on a 419-memory corpus it is never called.
modes.keyword_only: KEYWORD_ONLY=1: _vector_search returns [], so /recall is the keyword leg alone. Used to compare the two keyword implementations. Run for baseline and keyword_swap.

maturation.cold: fully wired: ingest, drain embedding + enrichment queues, recall
maturation.matured: NOT RUN: maturation-v1 is unfrozen and unimplemented (docs/eval/maturation.md); /consolidate has no reference_time

budget.enforcement: scripts/benchmarks/paid_budget_proxy.py with one shared absolute ledger; meili_bench.py budget gates projection
